title: nf-mirplan - params.input schema
description: Schema for the file provided with params.input

Species.errorMessage: The Species column must contain the scientific names of the species to be used and in the correct format

Project.errorMessage: An identifier for the projects must be specified. If the project comes from SRA, the BioProject can be used. Otherwise, the user can specify one of their choice.

File.errorMessage: The file must exist. Additionally, all entries in the File column must be either '.txt', '.fastq', '.fastq.gz' or '.tsv

Metadata.errorMessage: The file must exist. Additionally, all entries in the File column must be '.tsv'

Genome.errorMessage: The file must exist. Additionally, all entries in the File column must be '.tsv'

Group.errorMessage: The Group must be an integer
